title: How do wood frogs completely freeze solid and wake up months later?
angle: Explores the physiological magic of creatures that turn their bodies into solid ice during winter and thaw out alive in spring, revealing how scientists are studying this cellular freeze-drying to revolutionize human organ preservation.
description: An engaging, scientifically accurate exploration of the wood frog's miraculous ability to survive complete freezing, and how this biology inspires human organ preservation.
